root_cause.text: The driver acquires a device reference for the ICU device during probe but fails to release it on all error paths (e.g., probe deferral), causing a permanent device reference leak.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states "make sure to drop the reference taken when looking up the ICU device during probe also on probe failures (e.g. probe deferral)". The patch adds a `devm_add_action_or_reset()` call to automatically invoke `put_device()` on the ICU device, and removes the manual `platform_device_put(dmac->icu.pdev)` from the remove function, confirming that the reference was previously only released on successful removal, not on early probe failures.

intent_record.intent_summary: Introduce a helper to properly release a device reference, likely fixing a missing put_device during cleanup.
intent_record.what: Added a new static function rz_dmac_put_device that calls put_device on its argument, placed before rz_dmac_parse_of_icu.
intent_record.how: This function provides a convenient way to decrement the device reference count, intended for use as a devm action callback to ensure proper cleanup when a device is released.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add devres action to release reference to ICU device on driver removal or error, preventing a reference leak.
intent_record.what: Added a call to devm_add_action_or_reset(dev, rz_dmac_put_device, &dmac->icu.pdev->dev) after the phandle parse succeeds, with error handling that returns the error if registration fails.
intent_record.how: This registers a driver-managed cleanup action that will call rz_dmac_put_device on the ICU pdev device when the DMAC device is removed or the driver is unbound, ensuring proper reference count decrement and preventing a reference leak.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove unnecessary platform_device_put call in rz_dmac_remove to fix an unbalanced reference count or double-free bug.
intent_record.what: Removed the `platform_device_put(dmac->icu.pdev);` call and the preceding blank line from the `rz_dmac_remove` function.
intent_record.how: The removal prevents the reference count of `dmac->icu.pdev` from being decremented during driver removal, avoiding potential unbalanced reference counts or double-free situations.
